evidence: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1964_American_Football_League_draft: round 1, pick 4, Denver Broncos (pick acquired from Boston), Bob Brown, Tackle, Nebraska. He is the only Bob Brown in that draft.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1964_NFL_draft: pick 2, Philadelphia Eagles, Bob Brown (HOF), offensive tackle, Nebraska; pick 169, San Francisco 49ers, Bob Brown, tackle, Arkansas A&M (a different man).

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Brown_(offensive_lineman) and https://www.profootballhof.com/players/bob-boomer-brown: the Nebraska tackle was drafted in the first round in 1964 by both the Philadelphia Eagles and the AFL's Denver Broncos.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Brown_(defensive_lineman): the Arkansas AM&N lineman's draft is 1964 NFL round 13, pick 169; no AFL selection is listed.
corrections.note: The legacy lookup gives the 1964 AFL pick the college and position of the Arkansas AM&N namesake. The career on that row is the Nebraska tackle's, so the row is the Nebraska tackle's AFL selection.
